## Wrapped lines
Notes wrap, so most people move with gj and
gk: 5gj goes five screen rows down, and the
plain line numbers never say where that is.
Here every screen row has its own number,
so you see the count before you jump.
Right-click a note: menus move
with Ctrl-N and Ctrl-P too.
